# Agent Mascot
> A personalized macOS desktop companion for local AI coding-agent workflows.

## Canonical site
- [Agent Mascot](https://agentmascot.app/): Product explanation, workflow states, demonstration, compatibility, and Mac download.

## Product action
- [Generate a personalized mascot](https://app.agentmascot.app): Open the official Agent Mascot application.

## Key facts
- Agent Mascot is designed to live beside a local AI coding-agent workflow on macOS.
- The companion reflects whether the agent is idle, working, or needs input.
- Morphling.dmg is the downloadable Agent Mascot desktop application for Mac.
